title: Classify European conditional four-byte lookup
changes: Identify a conditional 74-row European two-field lookup projection and its original metadata and zero-value producers without imposing a global selector bound.
validation: Exact-ROM source pins, existing metadata52 values, conditional original row search witnesses for indices 1 through 73 and the distinct conditional zero path establish 296 non-overlapping source bytes; retained windows were disassembled under Wine.
limitations: Original live and out-of-range indices remain uncapped and raw. Typed model, managed runtime, ordinary use, Linux and USA remain open; no gameplay or performance measurement.
